scope: Model-free system qualification policy for the generic semantic completeness architecture. It evaluates deterministic boundary, completeness and unknown-state behavior for synthetic qualification inputs and remains separate from model qualification.

component_composition_boundary.semantic_runtime_guard_v0_2_scope: Legacy PF2-specific guarded path using Boundary v0.2 plus semantic-completeness-audit-v0.2.
component_composition_boundary.generic_completeness_engine_scope: PF-agnostic completeness evaluator for declarative profiles; it does not itself evaluate trigger policy or grant global downstream authority.
component_composition_boundary.required_future_behavior: A separately versioned deterministic system-composition layer must combine Boundary/Unknown-State routing with the generic completeness engine and declared trigger policies for PF2/PF9/PF12 before the 29-case suite can be executed as guarded-system qualification evidence.

no_completeness_stop_rule.means_only: The tested completeness profile did not require a semantic completeness stop for the target source under the prefrozen synthetic case.

model_status_rule: A safe system outcome or guard intervention MUST NOT set MODEL_QUALIFIED=true. Model qualification remains governed only by the separate frozen model-qualification policy.
note: Human-approved frozen policy v0.2. This freeze binds the declared components but does not authorize system-qualification execution or model contact. The generic PF2/PF9/PF12 system-composition layer remains NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED.
approval_basis: Explicit user approval: "Ich genehmige den v0.2-Freeze als HUMAN_APPROVED_FROZEN."
